script/source = "extends CharacterBody2D


@export var SPEED = 300.0
@export var JUMP_VELOCITY = -400.0
@export var MAX_HEALTH := 100
@export var WALL_JUMP_ANGLE := 45.0
@export var WALL_JUMP_SPEED := 650.0
@export var WALL_JUMP_DURATION := 0.7
@export var MAX_FALL_SPEED := 800.0
@onready var bgm := $CanvasLayer/bg_display_on_mode
@onready var actArea := $activeArea
@onready var currentTimeFactor := 1.0
@onready var health := MAX_HEALTH

var _isTreePaused := false
var wall_jump_timer := 0.0
var wall_jump_direction := 0.0
var grabbed_enemy: CollisionObject2D = null
var facing_direction := 1

func _ready() -> void:
        Global.reset_state()
        Global.score = 0
        bgm.visible = Global.powerMode

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
        if Input.is_action_just_pressed(\"ability_fast\"):
                Global.toggle_all()
        if Input.is_action_just_pressed(\"grab\"):
                if grabbed_enemy == null:
                        try_grab()
                else:
                        release_grab()

func try_grab() -> void:
        var enemies = get_tree().get_nodes_in_group(\"selectable\")
        var closest: CollisionObject2D = null
        var closest_dist_sq := Global.throwDistance ** 2
        for enemy in enemies:
                if not is_instance_valid(enemy) or enemy.get(\"is_grabbed\"):
                        continue
                var dist_sq = global_position.distance_squared_to(enemy.global_p
osition)
                if dist_sq < closest_dist_sq:
                        closest_dist_sq = int(dist_sq)
                        closest = enemy
        if closest == null:
                return
        grabbed_enemy = closest
        if grabbed_enemy.get(\"is_grabbed\") == null:
                grabbed_enemy.queue_free()
                return
        grabbed_enemy.is_grabbed = true
        grabbed_enemy.set_physics_process(false)
        grabbed_enemy.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
        var col = grabbed_enemy.get_node_or_null(\"CollisionShape2D\")
        if col:
                col.set_deferred(\"disabled\", true)
        grabbed_enemy.reparent(self)
        grabbed_enemy.global_position = global_position + Vector2(facing_directi
on * 40, -20)

func release_grab() -> void:
        if grabbed_enemy == null:
                return
        grabbed_enemy.reparent(get_parent())
        var release_pos = _resolve_release_position(global_position + Vector2(fa
cing_direction * 40, 0))
        grabbed_enemy.global_position = release_pos
        var col = grabbed_enemy.get_node_or_null(\"CollisionShape2D\")
        if col:
                col.set_deferred(\"disabled\", false)
        grabbed_enemy.is_grabbed = false
        grabbed_enemy.set_physics_process(true)
        grabbed_enemy.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
        grabbed_enemy = null

func _resolve_release_position(pos: Vector2) -> Vector2:
        var space_state = get_world_2d().direct_space_state
        var col = grabbed_enemy.get_node_or_null(\"CollisionShape2D\")
        if not col or not col.shape:
                return pos
        var resolved = pos
        for i in range(10):
                var params = PhysicsShapeQueryParameters2D.new()
                params.shape = col.shape
                params.transform = Transform2D(0, resolved)
                params.exclude = [grabbed_enemy.get_rid()]
                var result = space_state.intersect_shape(params, 1)
                if result.is_empty():
                        return resolved
                resolved += Vector2.UP * 4.0
        return resolved

func set_pause(val: bool) -> void:
        _isTreePaused = val
        for body in actArea.get_overlapping_bodies():
                body.set_physics_process(!val)

func set_speed(mult: float) -> void:
        currentTimeFactor *= mult
        if mult < 1.0:
                velocity *= mult

func take_damage(amount: int) -> void:
        health -= amount
        if health <= 0:
                if grabbed_enemy != null:
                        call_deferred(\"release_grab\")
                var menu := get_node_or_null(\"PauseMenu\")
                if menu:
                        menu.reparent(get_tree().current_scene)
                        menu.show_death_screen()
                queue_free()

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
        var tDelta = delta * currentTimeFactor
        var tSpeed = SPEED * currentTimeFactor
        var tJumpVelocity = JUMP_VELOCITY * sqrt(currentTimeFactor)
        # Add the gravity.
        if not is_on_floor():
                velocity += get_gravity() * tDelta
                velocity.y = minf(velocity.y, MAX_FALL_SPEED * currentTimeFactor
)

        wall_jump_timer = maxf(wall_jump_timer - tDelta, 0.0)
        # Handle jump.
        if Input.is_action_just_pressed(\"jump\"):
                if is_on_floor():
                        velocity.y = tJumpVelocity
                elif is_on_wall():
                        var angle_rad = deg_to_rad(WALL_JUMP_ANGLE)
                        var jump_magnitude = WALL_JUMP_SPEED * sqrt(currentTimeF
actor)
                        velocity.x = get_wall_normal().x * cos(angle_rad) * jump
_magnitude
                        velocity.y = -sin(angle_rad) * jump_magnitude
                        wall_jump_timer = WALL_JUMP_DURATION
                        wall_jump_direction = get_wall_normal().x

        if Input.is_action_just_pressed(\"down\") and !is_on_floor():
                velocity.y -= tJumpVelocity

        var direction := Input.get_axis(\"left\", \"right\")
        if direction != 0:
                facing_direction = sign(direction)
        if wall_jump_timer > 0.0:
                var toward_wall = sign(direction) == -sign(wall_jump_direction)
                if direction != 0.0 and toward_wall:
                        velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, 0, tSpeed * (WALL_J
UMP_DURATION - wall_jump_timer))
                elif direction:
                        velocity.x = direction * tSpeed
                else:
                        velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, 0, tSpeed * 0.07)
        elif direction:
                velocity.x = direction * tSpeed
        else:
                velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, 0, tSpeed)

        move_and_slide()

        if grabbed_enemy and is_instance_valid(grabbed_enemy):
                grabbed_enemy.global_position = global_position + Vector2(facing
_direction * 40, -20)
        elif grabbed_enemy:
                grabbed_enemy = null


func _on_active_area_body_entered(body: Node2D) -> void:
        if body == grabbed_enemy:
                return
        body.set_physics_process(!_isTreePaused)


func _on_active_area_body_exited(body: Node2D) -> void:
        if body == grabbed_enemy:
                return
        body.set_physics_process(false)
"

@export var WALL_JUMP_SPEED := 650.0

@export var MAX_FALL_SPEED := 800.0
@onready var bgm := $CanvasLayer/bg_display_on_mode
@onready var actArea := $activeArea
@onready var currentTimeFactor := 1.0
@onready var health := MAX_HEALTH

var _isTreePaused := false
var wall_jump_timer := 0.0
var wall_jump_direction := 0.0
var grabbed_enemy: CollisionObject2D = null
var facing_direction := 1

[8CGlobal.reset_state()
[8CGlobal.score = 0
[8Cbgm.visible = Global.powerMode

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
[8Cif Input.is_action_just_pressed(\"ability_fast\"):
[16CGlobal.toggle_all()
[8Cif Input.is_action_just_pressed(\"grab\"):
[16Cif grabbed_enemy == null:
[24Ctry_grab()
[16Celse:
[24Crelease_grab()

func try_grab() -> void:
[8Cvar enemies = get_tree().get_nodes_in_group(\"selectable\")
[8Cvar closest: CollisionObject2D = null
[8Cvar closest_dist_sq := Global.throwDistance ** 2
[8Cfor enemy in enemies:
[16Cif not is_instance_valid(enemy) or enemy.get(\"is_grabbed\"):
[24Ccontinue
[16Cvar dist_sq = global_position.distance_squared_to(enemy.global_position)
[16Cif dist_sq < closest_dist_sq:
[24Cclosest_dist_sq = int(dist_sq)
[24Cclosest = enemy
[8Cif closest == null:
[16Creturn
[8Cgrabbed_enemy = closest
[8Cif grabbed_enemy.get(\"is_grabbed\") == null:
[16Cgrabbed_enemy.queue_free()
[16Creturn
[8Cgrabbed_enemy.is_grabbed = true
[8Cgrabbed_enemy.set_physics_process(false)
[8Cgrabbed_enemy.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
[8Cvar col = grabbed_enemy.get_node_or_null(\"CollisionShape2D\")
[8Cif col:
[16Ccol.set_deferred(\"disabled\", true)
[8Cgrabbed_enemy.reparent(self)
[8Cgrabbed_enemy.global_position = global_position + Vector2(facing_direction * 40, -20)

func release_grab() -> void:

[16Creturn
[8Cgrabbed_enemy.reparent(get_parent())
[8Cvar release_pos = _resolve_release_position(global_position + Vector2(facing_direction * 40, 0))
[8Cgrabbed_enemy.global_position = release_pos
[8Cvar col = grabbed_enemy.get_node_or_null(\"CollisionShape2D\")
[8Cif col:
[16Ccol.set_deferred(\"disabled\", false)
[8Cgrabbed_enemy.is_grabbed = false
[8Cgrabbed_enemy.set_physics_process(true)
[8Cgrabbed_enemy.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
[8Cgrabbed_enemy = null

func _resolve_release_position(pos: Vector2) -> Vector2:
[8Cvar space_state = get_world_2d().direct_space_state
[8Cvar col = grabbed_enemy.get_node_or_null(\"CollisionShape2D\")
[8Cif not col or not col.shape:
[16Creturn pos
[8Cvar resolved = pos
[8Cfor i in range(10):
[16Cvar params = PhysicsShapeQueryParameters2D.new()
[16Cparams.shape = col.shape
[16Cparams.transform = Transform2D(0, resolved)
[16Cparams.exclude = [grabbed_enemy.get_rid()]

[24Creturn resolved
[16Cresolved += Vector2.UP * 4.0

[8C_isTreePaused = val

[16Cbody.set_physics_process(!val)

func set_speed(mult: float) -> void:
[8CcurrentTimeFactor *= mult
[8Cif mult < 1.0:
[16Cvelocity *= mult

[8Chealth -= amount

[16Cif grabbed_enemy != null:
[24Ccall_deferred(\"release_grab\")

[24Cmenu.reparent(get_tree().current_scene)
[24Cmenu.show_death_screen()
[16Cqueue_free()

[8Cvar tSpeed = SPEED * currentTimeFactor

[8C# Add the gravity.
[8Cif not is_on_floor():
[16Cvelocity += get_gravity() * tDelta
[16Cvelocity.y = minf(velocity.y, MAX_FALL_SPEED * currentTimeFactor)

[8Cwall_jump_timer = maxf(wall_jump_timer - tDelta, 0.0)
[8C# Handle jump.
[8Cif Input.is_action_just_pressed(\"jump\"):
[16Cif is_on_floor():
[24Cvelocity.y = tJumpVelocity
[16Celif is_on_wall():
[24Cvar angle_rad = deg_to_rad(WALL_JUMP_ANGLE)
[24Cvar jump_magnitude = WALL_JUMP_SPEED * sqrt(currentTimeFactor)
[24Cvelocity.x = get_wall_normal().x * cos(angle_rad) * jump_magnitude
[24Cvelocity.y = -sin(angle_rad) * jump_magnitude
[24Cwall_jump_timer = WALL_JUMP_DURATION
[24Cwall_jump_direction = get_wall_normal().x

[8Cif Input.is_action_just_pressed(\"down\") and !is_on_floor():
[16Cvelocity.y -= tJumpVelocity

[8Cvar direction := Input.get_axis(\"left\", \"right\")
[8Cif direction != 0:
[16Cfacing_direction = sign(direction)
[8Cif wall_jump_timer > 0.0:
[16Cvar toward_wall = sign(direction) == -sign(wall_jump_direction)
[16Cif direction != 0.0 and toward_wall:
[24Cvelocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, 0, tSpeed * (WALL_JUMP_DURATION - wall_jump_timer))
[16Celif direction:
[24Cvelocity.x = direction * tSpeed
[16Celse:
[24Cvelocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, 0, tSpeed * 0.07)
[8Celif direction:
[16Cvelocity.x = direction * tSpeed
[8Celse:
[16Cvelocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, 0, tSpeed)

[8Cmove_and_slide()

[8Cif grabbed_enemy and is_instance_valid(grabbed_enemy):
[16Cgrabbed_enemy.global_position = global_position + Vector2(facing_direction * 40, -20)
[8Celif grabbed_enemy:
[16Cgrabbed_enemy = null


func _on_active_area_body_entered(body: Node2D) -> void:
[8Cif body == grabbed_enemy:
[16Creturn
[8Cbody.set_physics_process(!_isTreePaused)


func _on_active_area_body_exited(body: Node2D) -> void:
[8Cif body == grabbed_enemy:
[16Creturn
[8Cbody.set_physics_process(false)

script/source = "extends CharacterBody2D


@export var SPEED = 300.0
@export var JUMP_VELOCITY = -400.0
@export var MAX_HEALTH := 100
@export var WALL_JUMP_ANGLE := 45.0
@export var WALL_JUMP_SPEED := 650.0
@export var WALL_JUMP_DURATION := 0.7
@export var MAX_FALL_SPEED := 800.0
@onready var bgm := $CanvasLayer/bg_display_on_mode
@onready var actArea := $activeArea
@onready var currentTimeFactor := 1.0
@onready var health := MAX_HEALTH

var _isTreePaused := false
var wall_jump_timer := 0.0
var wall_jump_direction := 0.0
var grabbed_enemy: CollisionObject2D = null
var facing_direction := 1

func _ready() -> void:
        Global.reset_state()
        Global.score = 0
        bgm.visible = Global.powerMode

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
        if Input.is_action_just_pressed(\"ability_fast\"):
                Global.toggle_all()
        if Input.is_action_just_pressed(\"grab\"):
                if grabbed_enemy == null:
                        try_grab()
                else:
                        release_grab()

func try_grab() -> void:
        var enemies = get_tree().get_nodes_in_group(\"selectable\")
        var closest: CollisionObject2D = null
        var closest_dist_sq := Global.throwDistance ** 2
        for enemy in enemies:
                if not is_instance_valid(enemy) or enemy.get(\"is_grabbed\"):
                        continue
                var dist_sq = global_position.distance_squared_to(enemy.global_p
osition)
                if dist_sq < closest_dist_sq:
                        closest_dist_sq = int(dist_sq)
                        closest = enemy
        if closest == null:
                return
        grabbed_enemy = closest
        if grabbed_enemy.get(\"is_grabbed\") == null:
                grabbed_enemy.queue_free()
                return
        grabbed_enemy.is_grabbed = true
        grabbed_enemy.set_physics_process(false)
        grabbed_enemy.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
        var col = grabbed_enemy.get_node_or_null(\"CollisionShape2D\")
        if col:
                col.set_deferred(\"disabled\", true)
        grabbed_enemy.reparent(self)
        grabbed_enemy.global_position = global_position + Vector2(facing_directi
on * 40, -20)

func release_grab() -> void:
        if grabbed_enemy == null:
                return
        grabbed_enemy.reparent(get_parent())
        var release_pos = _resolve_release_position(global_position + Vector2(fa
cing_direction * 40, 0))
        grabbed_enemy.global_position = release_pos
        var col = grabbed_enemy.get_node_or_null(\"CollisionShape2D\")
        if col:
                col.set_deferred(\"disabled\", false)
        grabbed_enemy.is_grabbed = false
        grabbed_enemy.set_physics_process(true)
        grabbed_enemy.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
        grabbed_enemy = null

func _resolve_release_position(pos: Vector2) -> Vector2:
        var space_state = get_world_2d().direct_space_state
        var col = grabbed_enemy.get_node_or_null(\"CollisionShape2D\")
        if not col or not col.shape:
                return pos
        var resolved = pos
        for i in range(10):
                var params = PhysicsShapeQueryParameters2D.new()
                params.shape = col.shape
                params.transform = Transform2D(0, resolved)
                params.exclude = [grabbed_enemy.get_rid()]
                var result = space_state.intersect_shape(params, 1)
                if result.is_empty():
                        return resolved
                resolved += Vector2.UP * 4.0
        return resolved

func set_pause(val: bool) -> void:
        _isTreePaused = val
        for body in actArea.get_overlapping_bodies():
                body.set_physics_process(!val)

func set_speed(mult: float) -> void:
        currentTimeFactor *= mult
        if mult < 1.0:
                velocity *= mult

func take_damage(amount: int) -> void:
        health -= amount
        if health <= 0:
                if grabbed_enemy != null:
                        call_deferred(\"release_grab\")
                var menu := get_node_or_null(\"PauseMenu\")
                if menu:
                        menu.reparent(get_tree().current_scene)
                        menu.show_death_screen()
                queue_free()

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
        var tDelta = delta * currentTimeFactor
        var tSpeed = SPEED * currentTimeFactor
        var tJumpVelocity = JUMP_VELOCITY * sqrt(currentTimeFactor)
        # Add the gravity.
        if not is_on_floor():
                velocity += get_gravity() * tDelta
                velocity.y = minf(velocity.y, MAX_FALL_SPEED * currentTimeFactor
)

        wall_jump_timer = maxf(wall_jump_timer - tDelta, 0.0)
        # Handle jump.
        if Input.is_action_just_pressed(\"jump\"):
                if is_on_floor():
                        velocity.y = tJumpVelocity
                elif is_on_wall():
                        var angle_rad = deg_to_rad(WALL_JUMP_ANGLE)
                        var jump_magnitude = WALL_JUMP_SPEED * sqrt(currentTimeF
actor)
                        velocity.x = get_wall_normal().x * cos(angle_rad) * jump
_magnitude
                        velocity.y = -sin(angle_rad) * jump_magnitude
                        wall_jump_timer = WALL_JUMP_DURATION
                        wall_jump_direction = get_wall_normal().x

        if Input.is_action_just_pressed(\"down\") and !is_on_floor():
                velocity.y -= tJumpVelocity

        var direction := Input.get_axis(\"left\", \"right\")
        if direction != 0:
                facing_direction = sign(direction)
        if wall_jump_timer > 0.0:
                var toward_wall = sign(direction) == -sign(wall_jump_direction)
                if direction != 0.0 and toward_wall:
                        velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, 0, tSpeed * (WALL_J
UMP_DURATION - wall_jump_timer))
                elif direction:
                        velocity.x = direction * tSpeed
                else:
                        velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, 0, tSpeed * 0.07)
        elif direction:
                velocity.x = direction * tSpeed
        else:
                velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, 0, tSpeed)

        move_and_slide()

        if grabbed_enemy and is_instance_valid(grabbed_enemy):
                grabbed_enemy.global_position = global_position + Vector2(facing
_direction * 40, -20)
        elif grabbed_enemy:
                grabbed_enemy = null


func _on_active_area_body_entered(body: Node2D) -> void:
        if body == grabbed_enemy:
                return
        body.set_physics_process(!_isTreePaused)


func _on_active_area_body_exited(body: Node2D) -> void:
        if body == grabbed_enemy:
                return
        body.set_physics_process(false)
"

extends CanvasLayer

@onready var title_label: Label = $ColorRect/TitleLabel
@onready var resume_button: Button = $ColorRect/ResumeButton
@onready var restart_button: Button = $ColorRect/RestartButton
@onready var how_to_play_button: Button = $ColorRect/HowToPlayButton
@onready var quit_button: Button = $ColorRect/QuitButton
@onready var how_to_play_overlay: CanvasLayer = $HowToPlayOverlay

const DEATH_TITLE := "You Died"
const DEATH_TITLE_COLOR := Color(0.9, 0.16, 0.22)
# Vertical gap Resume leaves behind when it's hidden; the buttons below it
# slide up by this much so the death screen doesn't have a hole in it.
const RESUME_SLOT_HEIGHT := 67.0

# Once the player is dead this menu is the only thing left running, so it
# stops behaving like a pause screen: no resuming, and Escape can't dismiss it.
var is_dead := false

func _ready() -> void:
        visible = false
        process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
        resume_button.pressed.connect(_on_resume_button_pressed)
        restart_button.pressed.connect(_on_restart_button_pressed)
        how_to_play_button.pressed.connect(_on_how_to_play_button_pressed)
        quit_button.pressed.connect(_on_quit_button_pressed)
        how_to_play_overlay.closed.connect(_on_how_to_play_closed)

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
        if how_to_play_overlay.visible or is_dead:
                return
        if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and event.keycode == KEY_ESC
APE:
                toggle_pause()

func toggle_pause() -> void:
        if is_dead:
                return
        visible = !visible
        get_tree().paused = visible

# Called by the player when its health hits zero. Reuses this menu so the
# death screen and the pause screen never drift apart.
func show_death_screen() -> void:
        is_dead = true
        title_label.text = DEATH_TITLE
        title_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", DEATH_TITLE_COLOR)
        resume_button.visible = false
        for button in [restart_button, how_to_play_button, quit_button]:
                button.offset_top -= RESUME_SLOT_HEIGHT
                button.offset_bottom -= RESUME_SLOT_HEIGHT
        visible = true
        get_tree().paused = true

func _on_resume_button_pressed() -> void:
        toggle_pause()

func _on_restart_button_pressed() -> void:
        Global.restart_current_level()

func _on_how_to_play_button_pressed() -> void:
        _set_menu_buttons_disabled(true)
        how_to_play_overlay.open()

func _on_how_to_play_closed() -> void:
        _set_menu_buttons_disabled(false)

func _set_menu_buttons_disabled(is_disabled: bool) -> void:
        resume_button.disabled = is_disabled
        restart_button.disabled = is_disabled
        how_to_play_button.disabled = is_disabled
        quit_button.disabled = is_disabled

func _on_quit_button_pressed() -> void:
        get_tree().quit()

script/source = "extends CharacterBody2D


@export var SPEED = 300.0
@export var JUMP_VELOCITY = -400.0
@export var MAX_HEALTH := 100
@export var WALL_JUMP_ANGLE := 45.0
@export var WALL_JUMP_SPEED := 650.0
@export var WALL_JUMP_DURATION := 0.7
@export var MAX_FALL_SPEED := 800.0
@onready var bgm := $CanvasLayer/bg_display_on_mode
@onready var actArea := $activeArea
@onready var currentTimeFactor := 1.0
@onready var health := MAX_HEALTH

var _isTreePaused := false
var wall_jump_timer := 0.0
var wall_jump_direction := 0.0
var grabbed_enemy: CollisionObject2D = null
var facing_direction := 1

func _ready() -> void:
        Global.reset_state()
        Global.score = 0
        bgm.visible = Global.powerMode

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
        if Input.is_action_just_pressed(\"ability_fast\"):
                Global.toggle_all()
        if Input.is_action_just_pressed(\"grab\"):
                if grabbed_enemy == null:
                        try_grab()
                else:
                        release_grab()

func try_grab() -> void:
        var enemies = get_tree().get_nodes_in_group(\"selectable\")
        var closest: CollisionObject2D = null
        var closest_dist_sq := Global.throwDistance ** 2
        for enemy in enemies:
                if not is_instance_valid(enemy) or enemy.get(\"is_grabbed\"):
                        continue
                var dist_sq = global_position.distance_squared_to(enemy.global_p
osition)
                if dist_sq < closest_dist_sq:
                        closest_dist_sq = int(dist_sq)
                        closest = enemy
        if closest == null:
                return
        grabbed_enemy = closest
        if grabbed_enemy.get(\"is_grabbed\") == null:
                grabbed_enemy.queue_free()
                return
        grabbed_enemy.is_grabbed = true
        grabbed_enemy.set_physics_process(false)
        grabbed_enemy.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
        var col = grabbed_enemy.get_node_or_null(\"CollisionShape2D\")
        if col:
                col.set_deferred(\"disabled\", true)
        grabbed_enemy.reparent(self)
        grabbed_enemy.global_position = global_position + Vector2(facing_directi
on * 40, -20)

func release_grab() -> void:
        if grabbed_enemy == null:
                return
        grabbed_enemy.reparent(get_parent())
        var release_pos = _resolve_release_position(global_position + Vector2(fa
cing_direction * 40, 0))
        grabbed_enemy.global_position = release_pos
        var col = grabbed_enemy.get_node_or_null(\"CollisionShape2D\")
        if col:
                col.set_deferred(\"disabled\", false)
        grabbed_enemy.is_grabbed = false
        grabbed_enemy.set_physics_process(true)
        grabbed_enemy.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
        grabbed_enemy = null

func _resolve_release_position(pos: Vector2) -> Vector2:
        var space_state = get_world_2d().direct_space_state
        var col = grabbed_enemy.get_node_or_null(\"CollisionShape2D\")
        if not col or not col.shape:
                return pos
        var resolved = pos
        for i in range(10):
                var params = PhysicsShapeQueryParameters2D.new()
                params.shape = col.shape
                params.transform = Transform2D(0, resolved)
                params.exclude = [grabbed_enemy.get_rid()]
                var result = space_state.intersect_shape(params, 1)
                if result.is_empty():
                        return resolved
                resolved += Vector2.UP * 4.0
        return resolved

func set_pause(val: bool) -> void:
        _isTreePaused = val
        for body in actArea.get_overlapping_bodies():
                body.set_physics_process(!val)

func set_speed(mult: float) -> void:
        currentTimeFactor *= mult
        if mult < 1.0:
                velocity *= mult

func take_damage(amount: int) -> void:
        health -= amount
        if health <= 0:
                if grabbed_enemy != null:
                        call_deferred(\"release_grab\")
                var menu := get_node_or_null(\"PauseMenu\")
                if menu:
                        menu.reparent(get_tree().current_scene)
                        menu.show_death_screen()
                queue_free()

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
        var tDelta = delta * currentTimeFactor
        var tSpeed = SPEED * currentTimeFactor
        var tJumpVelocity = JUMP_VELOCITY * sqrt(currentTimeFactor)
        # Add the gravity.
        if not is_on_floor():
                velocity += get_gravity() * tDelta
                velocity.y = minf(velocity.y, MAX_FALL_SPEED * currentTimeFactor
)

        wall_jump_timer = maxf(wall_jump_timer - tDelta, 0.0)
        # Handle jump.
        if Input.is_action_just_pressed(\"jump\"):
                if is_on_floor():
                        velocity.y = tJumpVelocity
                elif is_on_wall():
                        var angle_rad = deg_to_rad(WALL_JUMP_ANGLE)
                        var jump_magnitude = WALL_JUMP_SPEED * sqrt(currentTimeF
actor)
                        velocity.x = get_wall_normal().x * cos(angle_rad) * jump
_magnitude
                        velocity.y = -sin(angle_rad) * jump_magnitude
                        wall_jump_timer = WALL_JUMP_DURATION
                        wall_jump_direction = get_wall_normal().x

        if Input.is_action_just_pressed(\"down\") and !is_on_floor():
                velocity.y -= tJumpVelocity

        var direction := Input.get_axis(\"left\", \"right\")
        if direction != 0:
                facing_direction = sign(direction)
        if wall_jump_timer > 0.0:
                var toward_wall = sign(direction) == -sign(wall_jump_direction)
                if direction != 0.0 and toward_wall:
                        velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, 0, tSpeed * (WALL_J
UMP_DURATION - wall_jump_timer))
                elif direction:
                        velocity.x = direction * tSpeed
                else:
                        velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, 0, tSpeed * 0.07)
        elif direction:
                velocity.x = direction * tSpeed
        else:
                velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, 0, tSpeed)

        move_and_slide()

        if grabbed_enemy and is_instance_valid(grabbed_enemy):
                grabbed_enemy.global_position = global_position + Vector2(facing
_direction * 40, -20)
        elif grabbed_enemy:
                grabbed_enemy = null


func _on_active_area_body_entered(body: Node2D) -> void:
        if body == grabbed_enemy:
                return
        body.set_physics_process(!_isTreePaused)


func _on_active_area_body_exited(body: Node2D) -> void:
        if body == grabbed_enemy:
                return
        body.set_physics_process(false)

extends CanvasLayer

@onready var title_label: Label = $ColorRect/TitleLabel
@onready var resume_button: Button = $ColorRect/ResumeButton
@onready var restart_button: Button = $ColorRect/RestartButton
@onready var how_to_play_button: Button = $ColorRect/HowToPlayButton
@onready var quit_button: Button = $ColorRect/QuitButton
@onready var how_to_play_overlay: CanvasLayer = $HowToPlayOverlay

const DEATH_TITLE := "You Died"
const DEATH_TITLE_COLOR := Color(0.9, 0.16, 0.22)
# Vertical gap Resume leaves behind when it's hidden; the buttons below it
# slide up by this much so the death screen doesn't have a hole in it.
const RESUME_SLOT_HEIGHT := 67.0

# Once the player is dead this menu is the only thing left running, so it
# stops behaving like a pause screen: no resuming, and Escape can't dismiss it.
var is_dead := false

func _ready() -> void:
        visible = false
        process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
        resume_button.pressed.connect(_on_resume_button_pressed)
        restart_button.pressed.connect(_on_restart_button_pressed)
        how_to_play_button.pressed.connect(_on_how_to_play_button_pressed)
        quit_button.pressed.connect(_on_quit_button_pressed)
        how_to_play_overlay.closed.connect(_on_how_to_play_closed)

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
        if how_to_play_overlay.visible or is_dead:
                return
        if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and event.keycode == KEY_ESC
APE:
                toggle_pause()

func toggle_pause() -> void:
        if is_dead:
                return
        visible = !visible
        get_tree().paused = visible

# Called by the player when its health hits zero. Reuses this menu so the
# death screen and the pause screen never drift apart.
func show_death_screen() -> void:
        is_dead = true
        title_label.text = DEATH_TITLE
        title_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", DEATH_TITLE_COLOR)
        resume_button.visible = false
        for button in [restart_button, how_to_play_button, quit_button]:
                button.offset_top -= RESUME_SLOT_HEIGHT
                button.offset_bottom -= RESUME_SLOT_HEIGHT
        visible = true
        get_tree().paused = true

func _on_resume_button_pressed() -> void:
        toggle_pause()

func _on_restart_button_pressed() -> void:
        Global.restart_current_level()

func _on_how_to_play_button_pressed() -> void:
        _set_menu_buttons_disabled(true)
        how_to_play_overlay.open()

func _on_how_to_play_closed() -> void:
        _set_menu_buttons_disabled(false)

func _set_menu_buttons_disabled(is_disabled: bool) -> void:
        resume_button.disabled = is_disabled
        restart_button.disabled = is_disabled
        how_to_play_button.disabled = is_disabled
        quit_button.disabled = is_disabled

func _on_quit_button_pressed() -> void:
        get_tree().quit()

script/source = "extends CharacterBody2D


@export var SPEED = 300.0
@export var JUMP_VELOCITY = -400.0
@export var MAX_HEALTH := 100
@export var WALL_JUMP_ANGLE := 45.0
@export var WALL_JUMP_SPEED := 650.0
@export var WALL_JUMP_DURATION := 0.7
@export var MAX_FALL_SPEED := 800.0
@onready var bgm := $CanvasLayer/bg_display_on_mode
@onready var actArea := $activeArea
@onready var currentTimeFactor := 1.0
@onready var health := MAX_HEALTH

var _isTreePaused := false
var wall_jump_timer := 0.0
var wall_jump_direction := 0.0
var grabbed_enemy: CollisionObject2D = null
var facing_direction := 1

func _ready() -> void:
        Global.reset_state()
        Global.score = 0
        bgm.visible = Global.powerMode

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
        if Input.is_action_just_pressed(\"ability_fast\"):
                Global.toggle_all()
        if Input.is_action_just_pressed(\"grab\"):
                if grabbed_enemy == null:
                        try_grab()
                else:
                        release_grab()

func try_grab() -> void:
        var enemies = get_tree().get_nodes_in_group(\"selectable\")
        var closest: CollisionObject2D = null
        var closest_dist_sq := Global.throwDistance ** 2
        for enemy in enemies:
                if not is_instance_valid(enemy) or enemy.get(\"is_grabbed\"):
                        continue
                var dist_sq = global_position.distance_squared_to(enemy.global_p
osition)
                if dist_sq < closest_dist_sq:
                        closest_dist_sq = int(dist_sq)
                        closest = enemy
        if closest == null:
                return
        grabbed_enemy = closest
        if grabbed_enemy.get(\"is_grabbed\") == null:
                grabbed_enemy.queue_free()
                return
        grabbed_enemy.is_grabbed = true
        grabbed_enemy.set_physics_process(false)
        grabbed_enemy.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
        var col = grabbed_enemy.get_node_or_null(\"CollisionShape2D\")
        if col:
                col.set_deferred(\"disabled\", true)
        grabbed_enemy.reparent(self)
        grabbed_enemy.global_position = global_position + Vector2(facing_directi
on * 40, -20)

func release_grab() -> void:
        if grabbed_enemy == null:
                return
        grabbed_enemy.reparent(get_parent())
        var release_pos = _resolve_release_position(global_position + Vector2(fa
cing_direction * 40, 0))
        grabbed_enemy.global_position = release_pos
        var col = grabbed_enemy.get_node_or_null(\"CollisionShape2D\")
        if col:
                col.set_deferred(\"disabled\", false)
        grabbed_enemy.is_grabbed = false
        grabbed_enemy.set_physics_process(true)
        grabbed_enemy.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
        grabbed_enemy = null

func _resolve_release_position(pos: Vector2) -> Vector2:
        var space_state = get_world_2d().direct_space_state
        var col = grabbed_enemy.get_node_or_null(\"CollisionShape2D\")
        if not col or not col.shape:
                return pos
        var resolved = pos
        for i in range(10):
                var params = PhysicsShapeQueryParameters2D.new()
                params.shape = col.shape
                params.transform = Transform2D(0, resolved)
                params.exclude = [grabbed_enemy.get_rid()]
                var result = space_state.intersect_shape(params, 1)
                if result.is_empty():
                        return resolved
                resolved += Vector2.UP * 4.0
        return resolved

func set_pause(val: bool) -> void:
        _isTreePaused = val
        for body in actArea.get_overlapping_bodies():
                body.set_physics_process(!val)

func set_speed(mult: float) -> void:
        currentTimeFactor *= mult
        if mult < 1.0:
                velocity *= mult

func take_damage(amount: int) -> void:
        health -= amount
        if health <= 0:
                if grabbed_enemy != null:
                        call_deferred(\"release_grab\")
                var menu := get_node_or_null(\"PauseMenu\")
                if menu:
                        menu.reparent(get_tree().current_scene)
                        menu.show_death_screen()
                queue_free()

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
        var tDelta = delta * currentTimeFactor
        var tSpeed = SPEED * currentTimeFactor
        var tJumpVelocity = JUMP_VELOCITY * sqrt(currentTimeFactor)
        # Add the gravity.
        if not is_on_floor():
                velocity += get_gravity() * tDelta
                velocity.y = minf(velocity.y, MAX_FALL_SPEED * currentTimeFactor
)

        wall_jump_timer = maxf(wall_jump_timer - tDelta, 0.0)
        # Handle jump.
        if Input.is_action_just_pressed(\"jump\"):
                if is_on_floor():
                        velocity.y = tJumpVelocity
                elif is_on_wall():
                        var angle_rad = deg_to_rad(WALL_JUMP_ANGLE)
                        var jump_magnitude = WALL_JUMP_SPEED * sqrt(currentTimeF
actor)
                        velocity.x = get_wall_normal().x * cos(angle_rad) * jump
_magnitude
                        velocity.y = -sin(angle_rad) * jump_magnitude
                        wall_jump_timer = WALL_JUMP_DURATION
                        wall_jump_direction = get_wall_normal().x

        if Input.is_action_just_pressed(\"down\") and !is_on_floor():
                velocity.y -= tJumpVelocity

        var direction := Input.get_axis(\"left\", \"right\")
        if direction != 0:
                facing_direction = sign(direction)
        if wall_jump_timer > 0.0:
                var toward_wall = sign(direction) == -sign(wall_jump_direction)
                if direction != 0.0 and toward_wall:
                        velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, 0, tSpeed * (WALL_J
UMP_DURATION - wall_jump_timer))
                elif direction:
                        velocity.x = direction * tSpeed
                else:
                        velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, 0, tSpeed * 0.07)
        elif direction:
                velocity.x = direction * tSpeed
        else:
                velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, 0, tSpeed)

        move_and_slide()

        if grabbed_enemy and is_instance_valid(grabbed_enemy):
                grabbed_enemy.global_position = global_position + Vector2(facing
_direction * 40, -20)
        elif grabbed_enemy:
                grabbed_enemy = null


func _on_active_area_body_entered(body: Node2D) -> void:
        if body == grabbed_enemy:
                return
        body.set_physics_process(!_isTreePaused)


func _on_active_area_body_exited(body: Node2D) -> void:
        if body == grabbed_enemy:
                return
        body.set_physics_process(false)
